وَلَجَةٌ A place, (S,) or a cavern, in which passengers shelter themselves from rain &c.: pl. أَوْلَاجٌ and وَلَجٌ, (S, K,) [or rather the latter, which is omitted in the CK, is a coll. gen. n., of which ولجة is the n. un.] or وُلُجٌ. (L.) ―
-b2- Also, A bend, or place of bending, of a valley: (IAar:) pl. as above. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
